name: Healing Word
summary: Bonus Action: a creature you can see within 60 feet regains 2d4 + your spellcasting modifier Hit Points.
text: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains Hit Points equal to 2d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the healing increases by 2d4 for each slot level above 1.
